decision_scope: The method/input contract is reviewed for a retained deferral. No MR or colocalization algorithm or biological feature is scientifically validated by this review.

scope.outcome_dataset: GCST90132223 EUR rheumatoid arthritis case-control meta-analysis
scope.outcome: Rheumatoid arthritis susceptibility; not response among treated patients or clinical-trial efficacy
scope.region_rule: Versioned Ensembl 105 phenotype_pos 154405193 +/- 1000000; fixed from annotation, without association-peak or P-value selection
scope.reported_N_usage: Study-level descriptors only until exact release, analysis sample set and variant-level applicability are qualified. QTL AN is an allele count, not automatically individual N. Study case fraction is not disease population prevalence.
scope.reference_LD: 503 EUR samples from the retained 1000 Genomes/IGSR GRCh38 panel; external reference rather than either association study
scope.historical_reason: Complete release/annotation/source-availability lineage has not been qualified at January 2025. The retained GWAS metadata states last modified 2025-01-02 and was retrieved in October 2026. Those dates do not prove the underlying statistics were unavailable before origin, but neither original 2022 publication nor April 2023 annotation establishes eligibility of the exact retained processed lineage. January 2023 in old QC limitations must not be mistaken for a January 2025 qualification.

distinct_evidence_levels.claim: A specified variant or locus is associated with a defined phenotype in a specified population and study.
Conditional on coverage, model, priors and study compatibility, regional association patterns support or fail to distinguish shared versus distinct causal signals.
A specified genetic proxy evaluates an exposure-outcome causal hypothesis under stated identification assumptions.
does_not_establish: lifelong genetic effects equal a finite treatment

distinct_evidence_levels.claim: Requires separately qualified assay, molecular species, functional mechanism, tissue, developmental timing and intervention correspondence plus triangulation.
distinct_evidence_levels.current_status: unqualified; transcript sign cannot set inhibit/activate

nonzero exposure beta and exposure SE

method_routes.arithmetic: ratio=beta_outcome/beta_exposure; first-order SE=SE_outcome/abs(beta_exposure) assumes negligible exposure-estimation error and suitable independence. Full delta/Fieller or weak-instrument-robust inference must be selected where first-order assumptions are unsuitable; never silently omit covariance under unqualified overlap.
identification_assumptions: relevance: proxy genuinely influences the specified exposure with sufficient strength
independence: proxy not associated with confounding pathways, considering ancestry/selection/relatedness
exclusion restriction: outcome association operates through specified exposure, not a horizontal pleiotropic path or neighboring gene
consistency/intervention correspondence and transport assumptions for a causal effect interpretation
strength_and_sensitivity: report approximate per-instrument F=(beta_exposure/SE_exposure)^2 with model limitations
freeze selection/strength rules before outcome analysis; never relax threshold to manufacture an instrument
address winner's curse, weak-denominator uncertainty, sample overlap and selection
colocalization can address linked distinct signals but cannot prove mediation or exclusion restriction
one instrument cannot support instrument-heterogeneity or MR-Egger pleiotropy diagnostics
method_routes.current_qualification: deferred; no prespecified scientifically qualified instrument or estimator, overlap/source qualification or independent fixtures

retained_QC_disposition.existing_results: Public manifest reports 6120 IL6R QTL rows, 5325 unique variants, 5722 GWAS rows, 2979 LD-shared QC variants and 503 EUR reference individuals. Separate Science5 input revalidation freshly hashed all 38 files/93166905 bytes; counted 336006 eQTL/5722 GWAS/50412 LD rows; verified 503 EUR samples and 4096 LD entries with maximum absolute difference 3.4416913763379853e-15. These are technical checks, not MR/colocalization or biological validation.
retained_QC_disposition.neutral_shared_region: Input reviewer found 3968 shared valid-statistic allele keys after source-conflict exclusion without LD/MAF/significance filtering: 3187 nonpalindromic SNPs, 511 palindromic SNPs and 270 other variants. This is a method-review candidate count, not automatically a qualified ABF input. Identity/scale/source qualification remains necessary.
retained_QC_disposition.coverage_correction: The 2979-variant QC list is an LD-oriented pilot output, not automatically the coloc.abf input. Existing report excludes 146 no-exact-LD variants and 62 external-panel MAF<0.01 variants after other filters. Those are not necessary ABF exclusions. Reconstruct the complete method-eligible dense shared beta/SE region from retained full rows, retaining identity/conflict/statistic exclusions and documenting coverage. Resolve known identities of palindromic/non-SNP variants by method; do not impose signed-LD restrictions on a squared-Z method without justification.
retained_QC_disposition.conflicts: The GWAS duplicate allele-key with distinct rs2990223 estimates remains excluded unless source-qualified. Neither convenient duplicate choice nor significant-hit pruning is allowed.
technical_checks_not_scientific_proofs: sha256 rehash identifies retained bytes, not publisher trust
source-window coordinate check does not prove exhaustive biological-variant coverage
ALT-correlation recomputation verifies stored genotype transformation, not source study LD
finite/symmetric/unit diagonal does not verify allele order against study effects
expected rank<=502 for centered 503-sample LD is not proof of failure and does not justify arbitrary regularization
retained_QC_disposition.LD_documentation_discrepancy: Retained VCF has 2548 samples while provider README says 5248; discrepancy remains unresolved even though 503 EUR membership and arithmetic reproduce. Preserve source documentation exception separately from numeric matrix integrity.

source_discrepancy.disposition: Quarantine scientific feature use of the affected GWAS-dependent route while preserving all files, raw metadata and receipts. Repeated identical retrievals establish repeatability, not resolution. No evidence here implies every regional payload is corrupted.
source_discrepancy.separate_unverified_fact: Publisher payload MD5 678a83e0bca52db0a22f65b127c17157 is a different object; whole remote GWAS file was not retrieved/hashed. Local regional SHA256 verifies only the retained slice.
future_resolution_routes: publisher supplies corrected checksum or immutable matched metadata/payload release
independently authenticated source/version correspondence reconciles metadata and payload, recorded under a concrete source-trust policy before use

independent_numeric_admission_fixtures.acceptance_policy: Pin reference implementation and separate derivation, seed/input hashes, tolerances, full outputs, disagreements and reviewer provenance. Agreement validates implementation only, not causal assumptions. No production source MR/coloc is authorized by this review.

required.fixture: Wald/IVW analytic strong positive and negative effects
required.checks: Independent ratio/uncertainty and multi-instrument arithmetic; allele recoding invariance; exposure-only sign flip reverses ratio; exact scale conversion.

required.fixture: weak or zero exposure and unknown overlap
required.checks: Reject zero denominator; preserve weak/wide or unbounded uncertainty; first-order inference not silently used under violated assumptions; overlap unknown never set to zero.

required.fixture: ABF null, one-trait-only, shared and distinct signals
required.checks: Independent Bayes-factor/configuration sums agree with pinned coloc PP.H0-H4; posterior normalized, finite and stable under extreme log evidence; no weak H0/H1/H2 case becomes therapeutic failure.

Known-sdY quantitative and beta/variance binary routes execute in the pinned reference without invented unused fields; unknown-sdY and P-approximation paths fail when their actual required inputs are absent.

SNP permutations preserve correctly rejoined result; duplicate conflicting keys fail or remain excluded; dropping non-significant/LD-missing variants is detectable and changes coverage record; method-specific exclusion ledger retained.

required.fixture: multiple signals and conflicting MR/coloc evidence
required.checks: Single-causal ABF limitation exposed; qualified SuSiE reference distinguishes shared/nonshared signal pairs where identifiable; MR positive plus H3 or weak colocalization remains discordant/inconclusive.

required.fixture: signed LD, sample compatibility and singularity
required.checks: Known allele-flip and SNP-permutation faults rejected unless LD and effects consistently transformed; r-squared input rejected; non-PSD/invalid matrix diagnosed; expected singular PSD matrix handled only by a qualified algorithm; convergence and reference-LD sensitivity retained.

Transcript MR sign cannot emit inhibit/activate; association/coloc/MR are distinct fields; unavailable sources produce deferred/missing, not zero; January-2025 lineage rejects 2025-01-02 metadata/current annotations absent independent pre-origin proof.
